modelFamily.summary: The request label ‘Imagen 2 de ChatGPT’ is normalized to OpenAI GPT Image 2 (`gpt-image-2`). Globe has one available prompt-to-image route. Google Imagen 2 is a different, deprecated family and has no route or adapter in this runtime.
modelFamily.integrationDecision: Keep the exact OpenAI Images generations route and its poll completion driver. Do not infer OpenAI editing support from the provider docs: Globe exposes generation only until a dedicated multipart edit transport, route identity and governed evidence exist. Keep GPT Image 1.5 as its own sibling route, not as an alias of this card.

evidence.note: The reader is the availability authority for the internal workspace; availability is not inferred from catalog presence.
Local code decodes the retained PNG, verifies the alpha channel and rejects a transparent request whose bytes are fully opaque before recording effective background metadata.
The local Producer derives the background selector from route constraints, invalidates stale estimates and renders ready images on a tokenized checkerboard.
The provider identifies `gpt-image-2` as the image generation model and documents image generation/editing surfaces; the Globe route is narrower.

Primary guide for generation, edits, transparent backgrounds, flexible sizes, streaming and output constraints. Globe has implemented the transparent PNG path locally, but it remains unverified in the deployed runtime.
GPT Image 1.5, 1, 1 Mini and chatgpt-image-latest are deprecated; 1.5 must not remain a silent transparency fallback.
The current developer catalog names GPT Image 2 and fixes the API/runtime identity as `gpt-image-2`.
Google Imagen 1/2 is a separate deprecated family; it is not the OpenAI GPT Image 2 route requested here.
The governed Producer run generated image/png, settled 14 Globe credits and reached Listo under the exact route identity.
